items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (BlockStrap) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious PHP code through the template engine's 'styles' property. This flaw has a CVSS score of 10.0 and requires a manual patch, with new installations remaining vulnerable.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (Zero-Day)
items.summary: A critical code injection vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this flaw, which has a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Authentication Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated network attacker to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized read access to protected resources. This flaw has a critical impact, extending beyond the vulnerable component's security authority.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover / Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions, leading to account takeover and privilege escalation. This flaw, with a CVSS score of 9.1, was observed being exploited shortly after public disclosure.
